import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class ProblemE {
    public static int w, h;
    public static final int INF = 9999999;
    public static Set<Integer> result = new HashSet<Integer>();
    
    public static void dfs(int col, int row, int mask) {
        if (col >= w) {
            result.add(mask);
            return;
        }
        if (row >= 1) {
            dfs(col+1, row, mask|(1<<col));
        }
        if (row <= h - 2) {
            dfs(col+1, row, mask|(1<<(col+w*2)));
        }
        if (col >= 1) {
            dfs(col+1, row, mask|(1<<((col-1)+w)));
        }
        if (col <= w - 2) {
            dfs(col+1, row, mask|(1<<((col+1)+w)));
        }
        dfs(col+1, row, mask|(1<<(col+w)));
    }
    
    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        String[] line = br.readLine().split(" ");
        w = Integer.parseInt(line[0]);
        h = Integer.parseInt(line[1]);
        if (w > h) {
            int tmp = w;
            w = h;
            h = tmp;
        }
    
        int[][] dp = new int[h+1][1<<(w*3)];
        for (int i = 0 ; i <= h ; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(dp[i], INF);
        }
        dp[0][0] = 0;
        
        for (int i = 0 ; i < h ; i++) {
            result.clear();
            dfs(0, i, 0);
            for (int j = 0 ; j < 1<<(w*2) ; j++) {
                if (dp[i][j] != INF) {
                    for (int res : result) {
                        int next = (res | j);
                        int nextn = next >> w;
                        int add = Integer.bitCount(next & ((1<<w) - 1));
                        dp[i+1][nextn] = Math.min(dp[i+1][nextn], dp[i][j] + add);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        int answer = INF;
        for (int j = 0 ; j < 1<<(w*2) ; j++) {
            answer = Math.min(answer, dp[h][j] + Integer.bitCount(j));
        }
        System.out.println(h * w - answer);
    }
}

import java.io.*;

public class ProblemE {
    private static int cols, rows;
    private static final int LIMIT = 9999999;
    private static Set<Integer> candidates = new HashSet<Integer>();
    
    private static void traverse(int position, int depth, int configuration) {
        if (position >= cols) {
            candidates.add(configuration);
            return;
        }
        if (depth >= 1) {
            traverse(position+1, depth, configuration|(1<<position));
        }
        if (depth <= rows - 2) {
            traverse(position+1, depth, configuration|(1<<(position+cols*2)));
        }
        if (position >= 1) {
            traverse(position+1, depth, configuration|(1<<((position-1)+cols)));
        }
        if (position <= cols - 2) {
            traverse(position+1, depth, configuration|(1<<((position+1)+cols)));
        }
        traverse(position+1, depth, configuration|(1<<(position+cols)));
    }
    
    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        String[] parts = scanner.nextLine().trim().split(" +");
        cols = Integer.parseInt(parts[0]);
        rows = Integer.parseInt(parts[1]);
        if (cols > rows) {
            int swap = cols;
            cols = rows;
            rows = swap;
        }
    
        int[][] memo = new int[rows+1][1<<(cols*3)];
        for (int row = 0 ; row <= rows ; row++) {
            Arrays.fill(memo[row], LIMIT);
        }
        memo[0][0] = 0;
        
        for (int layer = 0 ; layer < rows ; layer++) {
            candidates.clear();
            traverse(0, layer, 0);
            for (int state = 0 ; state < 1<<(cols*2) ; state++) {
                if (memo[layer][state] != LIMIT) {
                    for (int candidate : candidates) {
                        int merged = (candidate | state);
                        int nextLayerState = merged >> cols;
                        int increment = Integer.bitCount(merged & ((1<<cols) - 1));
                        memo[layer+1][nextLayerState] = Math.min(memo[layer+1][nextLayerState], memo[layer][state] + increment);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        int optimal = LIMIT;
        for (int endState = 0 ; endState < 1<<(cols*2) ; endState++) {
            optimal = Math.min(optimal, memo[rows][endState] + Integer.bitCount(endState));
        }
        System.out.println(rows * cols - optimal);
    }
}

public class ProblemE {
    static int N, M;
    static final int BIG = 9999999;
    static Set<Integer> options = new HashSet<Integer>();
    
    static void search(int idx, int level, int pattern) {
        if (idx >= N) {
            options.add(pattern);
            return;
        }
        if (level >= 1) {
            search(idx+1, level, pattern|(1<<idx));
        }
        if (level <= M - 2) {
            search(idx+1, level, pattern|(1<<(idx+N*2)));
        }
        if (idx >= 1) {
            search(idx+1, level, pattern|(1<<((idx-1)+N)));
        }
        if (idx <= N - 2) {
            search(idx+1, level, pattern|(1<<((idx+1)+N)));
        }
        search(idx+1, level, pattern|(1<<(idx+N)));
    }
    
    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader in = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        String[] tokens = in.readLine().trim().split("\\s+");
        N = Integer.parseInt(tokens[0]);
        M = Integer.parseInt(tokens[1]);
        if (N > M) {
            int temp = N;
            N = M;
            M = temp;
        }
    
        int[][] cache = new int[M+1][1<<(N*3)];
        for (int i = 0 ; i <= M ; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(cache[i], BIG);
        }
        cache[0][0] = 0;
        
        for (int k = 0 ; k < M ; k++) {
            options.clear();
            search(0, k, 0);
            for (int s = 0 ; s < 1<<(N*2) ; s++) {
                if (cache[k][s] != BIG) {
                    for (int opt : options) {
                        int combined = (opt | s);
                        int nextS = combined >> N;
                        int cost = Integer.bitCount(combined & ((1<<N) - 1));
                        cache[k+1][nextS] = Math.min(cache[k+1][nextS], cache[k][s] + cost);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        int best = BIG;
        for (int t = 0 ; t < 1<<(N*2) ; t++) {
            best = Math.min(best, cache[M][t] + Integer.bitCount(t));
        }
        System.out.println(M * N - best);
    }
}

    private static int C, R;
    private static final int MAX_VAL = 9999999;

    private static void exploreAll(int index, int depth, int config) {
        if (index >= C) {
            variations.add(config);
            return;

        if (depth >= 1) {

        }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        String[] data = br.readLine().trim().split("\\s+");
        C = Integer.parseInt(data[0]);

                        memoTable[level+1][nextState] = Math.min(memoTable[level+1][nextState], memoTable[level][state] + added);

        int minimum = MAX_VAL;
        for (int finalState = 0 ; finalState < 1<<(C*2) ; finalState++) {
            minimum = Math.min(minimum, memoTable[R][finalState] + Integer.bitCount(finalState));
